misocialr: Access the Brazilian 'MDS' Social Information Matrix ('MI Social') API from 'R'

Source: R/misocialr-package.R
misocialr-package.Rd

'Tidyverse'-friendly interface to the 'MI Social' API of the Brazilian Ministry of Development and Social Assistance ('MDS', 'SAGI') https://aplicacoes.mds.gov.br/sagi/servicos/misocial. Retrieves monthly municipal series of the 'Cadastro Unico' (registered families and people by income bracket), the 'Bolsa Familia' programme (beneficiary families, benefits and transfers), the 'BPC' benefit, the social assistance network ('CRAS', 'CREAS' and other units), 'SUAS' funding, 'Bolsa Familia' conditionality monitoring and food security programmes as tidy long-format 'tibbles'.
